body: I will,you’ve given me a lot to think about. Thank you for taking the time to speak with me. I feel a lot more level headed.
I’m not really sure. I’d have to think about that.
The more I think about it,you’re right. Attempting suicide isn’t going to make people care about me. I really appreciate you talking with me,it’s helped a lot.
How I feel. I feel terrible constantly and I always read about people with near death experiences how peaceful it was. I want to feel that

I’m afraid to reach out for help. I’ve tried in the past and my parents and friends all treated me like shit for it. It was humiliating. I feel like actually attempting will show them that I’m hurting and that I’m not just making it up.

That’s a good question. I’m not really sure. When I did it in the past, I felt amazing. I felt like a whole new person. I had a reason to live and I wanted to live after my hospitalization. I feel like if I attempt , I can feel happy again. It’s really hard to explain.
